objectified_fact_types.description: The relationship 'Reviewer reviews Paper' is objectified as Review. The conference treats each review as an entity with its own identity (review_id) and attributes (review_score). This objectification is necessary because reviews are tracked independently and have their own properties beyond simply linking a reviewer to a paper.

ambiguities.description: Mandatory participation on Reviewer and Paper roles in 'Review is by Reviewer for Paper': The transcript states reviewers review papers and papers get reviewed, but it is not explicitly stated whether every Reviewer must conduct at least one review or whether every Paper must be reviewed by at least one reviewer. These reverse-direction mandatory constraints (if any) are not mentioned.
